notes: Amounts written out in words now work everywhere, and so do hours. "Trim it to twenty five minutes", "an hour and a half", "a hundred seconds" and "cut the first two hours" all understood — before, a lot of them quietly did nothing, and "shorten it to 2 hours" could hand back a five-minute montage instead. Asking to change part of a clip now always explains that Crisp works on the whole clip and offers to split it, whichever way you write the amount. "Brighten the first twenty seconds" used to return a twenty-second video and throw the rest away.
